reviews.title: Long overdue for updates and maintenance
reviews.text: I use this app, and I like the challenge and community aspect. But it is glitching a lot lately, and there has been no noticeable update in years, still no workable chat feature. The community aspect is the fun part, and there is almost no way to communicate. No way to add friends. Syncing doesn’t always work, you can’t see the history of your teams points anymore, etc. Would also be nice to have a way to kick people from your team. A lot of people are inactive or not syncing. The whole interface is pretty rudimentary and has lots of room for improvement. Also the way move goals are determined needs to be changed. A heavier person shouldn’t have to do more than double the work when in reality they are struggling more with lesser activity.

reviews.title: Great concept but, poor real time syncing

reviews.title: More features!
reviews.text:
I would like to propose two enhancements that could significantly improve the user experience:

1. Rest Days - “Rest Day Freeze” Mechanism:
The current structure does not accommodate rest days. I suggest implementing a “Rest Day Freeze” feature, where after a certain number of consecutive active days, users earn the option to take a rest day without penalty. During this rest day, users would receive their average daily points, maintaining their standing in the competition. This approach would allow users to prioritize recovery without the fear of losing progress.
2. In-App Communication Tools:
Currently, the app lacks a direct communication channel among users.

reviews.title: Great app for group challenges
reviews.text: I love that this app incorporates move calories, exercise minutes, stand minutes, etc. if you choose the Apple Watch rings option. Most other fitness challenge apps make you choose to compete in just one, like only a step challenge or only a move calories challenge. My friends and I use it to stay motivated and healthy. Some suggestions - when setting up the challenge, allow an option for a set number of rest days. Say for example, the person who created the challenges chooses 2 rest days, so everyone competing must list a day as a “rest day” twice, which means no points awarded that day.  I think this would help prevent people getting burnt out and quitting on long term challenges if this was an option that could be built in when creating a challenge. Also, I think the maximum daily points should be higher and be a clear even number like 100. Having a max of 98 points each day makes the math unnecessarily more difficult.

reviews.title: Rest days
reviews.text: I started using this with my coworkers as part of a weight loss challenge and it's great for keeping everyone motivated. I saw that there are allowed rest days at the end of the challenge, but it would be so much better to have an alloted number of rest days that people can chose to use when they need them depending on their schedules. It's ridiculous trying to get all points every single day for weeks and makes people much more prone to quitting.
